eyebrow: Teresa Lee · Founder of PHI OS
Teresa Lee · PHI OS 创办人
title: See your situation clearly. Find your own next step.
看清自己的处境，走出自己的下一步。
intro: Important choices in life often touch more than one thing.
生活中的重要选择，往往牵动不止一件事。
A career change may affect income, family and time with your children. A business decision may also shape cash flow, relationships and the life ahead.
一次职业转变，可能涉及收入、家庭与陪伴孩子的时间；一个事业决定，也可能同时影响现金流、关系和未来的生活。
I founded PHI OS to help people see these connections when facing a choice: what they are experiencing, the constraints they face, the possibilities that remain, and where a next step might begin.
我创立 PHI OS，希望让人们面对这些选择时，能够把相关的事情放在一起看清楚：自己正在经历什么、有哪些限制、还有哪些可能，以及下一步可以从哪里开始。
role: PHI OS 创办人兼首席架构师

title: Why did I found PHI OS?
为什么创立 PHI OS？
lead: Behind a decision, there is often a whole life.
一个决定背后，常常是一整个人生。
paragraphs: In financial planning and my continuing study of real-world problems, I repeatedly encountered the same situation: someone had listened to a great deal of advice and sincerely searched for answers, yet still did not know how to bring them back into their own life.
在财务规划与对现实问题的持续研究中，我反复遇见一种处境：一个人已经听过许多建议，也认真寻找过答案，却仍然不知道怎样把它们放回自己的生活。

Numbers can help us understand finances without fully explaining what a family is carrying. Personal analysis can offer a perspective without knowing what has recently changed in someone's life. A business plan that looks sound still needs time, resources and practical conditions to move forward.
数字可以帮助我们理解财务，却未必说清一个家庭正在承担什么。个人分析可以提供观察角度，却未必知道一个人最近经历了哪些变化。一份看起来合理的事业计划，也需要时间、资源和实际执行条件才能走下去。
Each way of understanding has value, and each has things it cannot see.
每一种理解都有价值，也各有看不见的地方。

I became increasingly interested in the connections between them: when family, work, money, personal feelings and the world around us change at the same time, how can we make judgments that fit reality more closely?
我逐渐关心的，是这些理解之间的联系：当家庭、工作、金钱、个人感受与外部环境同时发生变化时，我们怎样才能作出更贴近现实的判断？
PHI OS began with this question.
PHI OS 就从这个问题开始。

I wanted to create a place where people could read, explore and organize information, and also pause to reconsider: what is already clear, what still needs to be understood, and what is the question they are actually facing now?
我希望建立一个地方，让人可以阅读、探索、整理资料，也可以停下来重新看看：哪些事情已经清楚，哪些仍需要了解，什么才是自己此刻真正面对的问题。

title: From sustained thought to work you can read
从长期思考，到可以阅读的作品
lead: An idea needs to stand up to writing, organization and repeated review.
一个想法，需要经得起写作、整理与反复检查。
paragraphs: PHI OS is grounded in the reading, research, writing and practical reflection to which I continue to devote my work.
PHI OS 的基础，是我持续投入的阅读、研究、写作与实践思考。
This work gradually developed into eight volumes, connecting discussions of how reality forms, operates, continues, expands, differentiates and reconfigures, and how we observe it and find direction.
这些工作逐步形成八册书籍，围绕现实如何形成、运行、延续、扩展、分化、重构，以及我们如何观察和寻找方向，建立彼此连接的讨论。

Books hold the fuller arguments. Articles offer a way to begin with a smaller question. Diagrams help readers see relationships within the text. Different analytical methods and practical tools provide further starting points for exploration.
书籍容纳完整的论述；文章让人可以从一个较小的问题开始；图示帮助读者看见文字中的关系。不同的分析方法与实际工具，则提供进一步探索的入口。
You can start with an article that relates to your life, explore a public book preview, or learn how a method approaches a question.
你可以先读一篇与你有关的文章，看看一册书的公开预览，或了解一种方法怎样看待问题。
I hope these works invite people to read, and to take the questions they find back into their own lives.
我希望这些作品让人读得进去，也能带着其中的问题，重新观察自己的生活。

title: What makes it worthy of trust?
为什么值得信任？
lead: Trust begins with a willingness to explain the basis and the limits.
信任，来自愿意把依据与限制说清楚。
paragraphs: PHI OS uses different kinds of knowledge. Books and research provide frameworks for thought; real data helps us understand the wider world; practical experience keeps questions close to life; different methods bring their own perspectives.
PHI OS 使用不同类型的知识：书籍与研究提供思考框架，真实数据帮助我们认识外部世界，实践经验让问题贴近生活，不同方法则带来各自的观察角度。
They have different uses and need different kinds of scrutiny.
它们各有用途，也需要接受不同的检查。

Data needs a source, date and statistical scope. Experience needs its specific context. The relevance of an interpretation needs to be checked against facts and later changes. Insights from traditional or symbolic systems should retain their character as interpretations within those methods, to be considered with care by the person using them.
数据需要看来源、日期与统计范围；经验需要放回具体处境；一种解释是否适用，需要与事实和后来的变化对照。来自传统或象征体系的理解，也应该保留其方法性质，交由使用者审慎看待。
Finishing a book does not mean every view in it has been independently verified. Similar descriptions from several methods are also not enough to prove that they are correct.
书籍写成了，不代表其中每个观点都已获得独立验证。几种方法得出相近的描述，也不足以证明它们一定正确。
PHI OS therefore gives particular attention to these principles:
因此，PHI OS 重视几件事：
principles: Readers should be able to understand where information or an interpretation comes from.
读者应能理解一项资料或解释从哪里来。
When the basis is insufficient, say clearly what is still unknown.
依据不足时，清楚说明仍不知道什么。
New information and real experiences can change an earlier understanding.
新资料与真实经历，可以改变原来的理解。
Financial, legal, health and other professional judgments need the participation of qualified professionals within the relevant scope.
涉及财务、法律、健康或其他专业判断时，需要相应范围内的专业人员参与。
closing: These principles need to be put into practice in every piece of content, every tool and every customer experience, and remain open to continued scrutiny.
这些原则需要落实在每一篇内容、每一个工具和每一次客户体验中，也需要持续接受检验。

title: From understanding yourself to a wider reality
从认识自己，走向理解更大的现实
lead: Our lives are always connected to other people and the world.
我们的生活，始终与别人和世界相连。
paragraphs: Understanding yourself is a natural place to begin.
认识自己，是一个自然的起点。

But a person's situation also exists within families, teams, businesses, institutions and countries. Caring responsibilities, work arrangements, commercial conditions, public systems and economic changes can all affect an individual's choices.
但个人的处境，也存在于家庭、团队、企业、机构与国家之中。照顾责任、工作安排、商业条件、公共制度与经济变化，都可能影响一个人的选择。
PHI OS organizes its directions for exploration around these six subjects, connecting questions at different scales.
PHI OS 以这六个主体组织探索的方向，让不同尺度的问题能够彼此联系。

You might start with “Why have I felt so tired lately?” and gradually notice family responsibilities, working rhythms or financial pressure. A business question may lead you to consider customers, the owner's needs in life and changes in the industry.
你可以从“我最近为什么觉得疲惫”开始，也可能逐步看见家庭分工、工作节奏或财务压力；从一个企业问题开始，也可能需要继续了解客户、经营者的生活需要与行业变化。
As the question becomes clearer, you can decide what is worth exploring further. The content and functions currently available at each entrance are described on its corresponding page.
随着问题变得清楚，你可以决定哪些内容值得继续了解。每个入口目前开放的内容与功能，以对应页面的实际说明为准。

title: What does PHI OS hope to offer you?
PHI OS 希望为你带来什么？
lead: A little more understanding. A little more room to act.
多一分理解，也多一点行动的余地。
paragraphs: In an uncertain life, seeing even part of a situation more clearly can be of practical help.
面对不确定的生活，能够看清一部分，就可能带来实际的帮助。

You may discover that the most urgent issue is an arrangement you can adjust. You may need a few more pieces of information before comparing choices seriously. Or you may finally be able to explain your question clearly and begin a more useful conversation with your family or a professional.
也许你会发现，眼前最需要处理的是一个可以调整的安排；也许你需要先补齐几项资料，才能认真比较选择；也许你终于能把自己的问题说清楚，与家人或专业人员展开一次更有用的讨论。
PHI OS hopes to help you reach moments like these:
PHI OS 希望帮助你走到这样的时刻：
See what is happening, understand the conditions that affect one another, explore choices you might consider, and find one small thing you are willing to do.
看见正在发生的事，理解彼此牵动的条件，探索可以考虑的选择，并找到一件愿意付诸行动的小事。
After taking action, return to see what happened. Which ideas were supported? Which need to change? How is the next step different now?
行动以后，再回来看看发生了什么。哪些理解得到支持，哪些需要改变，下一步又有什么不同。
Life continues to change. We can continue learning how to meet it.
生活会继续变化，我们也可以继续学习怎样面对它。

title: The founder's commitment
创办人的承诺
quote: I hope PHI OS becomes a place where people can take the time to understand themselves and their lives seriously.
我希望 PHI OS 成为一个让人能够认真理解自己与生活的地方。
I will continue turning ideas into works people can explore, explaining their basis and limits, and taking the problems people encounter in their actual experience seriously.
我会继续把思想整理成作品，把依据与限制说清楚，也认真面对使用者在实际体验中遇到的问题。
For me, the value of a system must ultimately return to people's lives: has it helped someone see their situation more clearly, ask better questions and take a next step of their own?
对我来说，一套系统的价值，最终要回到人的生活里：它有没有帮助一个人看清处境、提出更好的问题，并走出属于自己的下一步。

title: Begin with one thing you care about now.
从你现在关心的一件事开始。
paragraphs: Read an article, explore a method, or look at practical tools that relate to your current situation.
先读一篇文章，了解一种方法，或看看与你当前处境有关的实际工具。
Begin with a question that matters to you, and build your understanding at your own pace.
从一个与你有关的问题开始，慢慢建立自己的理解。
closing: When you need another person to be involved, explore the scope and arrangements of professional services.
需要真人参与时，可以进一步了解专业服务的范围与安排。
